fusions.name: Loose Strands
fusions.desc: Flicks 4 strands of conjured hair out in a spread, each dealing 3 damage, with a 15% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Garrotte of Tresses
fusions.desc: Whips a braided cord of hair around an enemy at or below 25% health up to 4 tiles away and pulls it tight, dealing 24 damage, up to 1.2 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Cocoon of Braids
fusions.desc: Wraps you in a cocoon of woven hair that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Strand by Strand
fusions.desc: Every hit you land weaves a strand of hair onto you, up to 10. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per strand (60% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a strand falls away every 6 seconds.
